messages:
Olivia: Heads-up — planning a canary deploy for `inference-route:v2.14` tonight at 23:00 UTC. Owner: Olivia. Goal is to validate latency regresses and cache behavior. Please read checklist and react with :thumbsup: if you sign off.
Sam: I can prepare the canary pool and reserve capacity. ETA for reservation: 22:45 UTC.
Olivia: Thanks Sam. High-level rollout plan: canary 5% (15m) -> 25% (30m) -> 100% (gradual) assuming smoke checks pass. Rollback plan: flip routing to `v2.13` and drain canary nodes.
Jordan (oncall): I'll be oncall for the window 22:30-01:30 UTC. I'll monitor errors and token-level latency. If error rate > 0.5% for 5m or 99p latency increases > 30% we rollback.
Maria (product): Product OK if quality checks on top-k sampling and prompt regressions are within expected ranges. I'll run a quick sample set post-canary.
Lee (sre): SRE checklist: 1) infra autoscale tested 2) healthcheck config validated 3) rollback script ready. I've verified LB health endpoint and added a Runbook note.
Olivia: Pre-deploy checklist (please confirm each):
- [ ] Reserve capacity (Sam)
- [ ] CI green + no blocking CRs (Olivia)
- [ ] DB migrations? NONE for this release (confirm)
- [ ] Smoke test commands and thresholds (see below)
- [ ] Monitoring dashboards pinned and alerts set (Lee)
- [ ] Product sample set ready (Maria)
- [ ] Security quick-scan (security already approved last week)
Sam: Capacity reserved ✅. Canaries will run on cluster `dedicated-canary-3`.
Olivia: CI/CR status: main -> green, one non-blocking doc fix outstanding (not required).
Olivia: Smoke test snippet (run from deploy host):
```
# smoke: generate a short prompt and check 200 status + latency
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"inference-route:v2.14","prompt":"Hello world","max_tokens":16}' \
  | jq '{status: .status, latency_ms: .metadata.latency_ms, text: .choices[0].text}'
```
Olivia: Smoke pass criteria: HTTP 200, error field empty, 95p latency < 250ms, deterministic sample checks from Maria's prompt set match baseline quality (no hallucination spikes).
Maria (product): I'll run the 10 prompt smoke set immediately after the 5% canary cutover and post results here.
Lee (sre): Alerts: created temporary alert rule to escalate if 5xx > 0.5% over 5m and added Slack webhook to #incidents. Runbook link: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/canary-deploys
Jordan (oncall): I'll keep the error budget dashboard open and have channel notifications enabled. Ping me with @Jordan if something trips.
Olivia: Approvals: please react with :white_check_mark: once you verify your checklist item. We'll cut at 23:00 UTC if at least: SRE, Oncall, and Product have signed off.
Lee (sre): :white_check_mark: SRE done.
Sam: :white_check_mark: capacity & infra done.
Maria (product): :white_check_mark: product smoke set ready.
Jordan (oncall): :white_check_mark: oncall ready.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for `inference-route:v2.14` at 2026-03-18T23:00:00Z. Watch: #eng-releases and #incidents.
Olivia: Final notes: if anything looks off at 5% we pause and triage for 10m. If OK, move to 25% after 15m. Document any deviation here. Thanks all — will post live status during the rollout.
Sam: I'll post a short confirmation message when canary cut is complete.
Maria (product): Copy — will post sample diffs.
Jordan (oncall): Ready on standby.
Lee (sre): I'll keep rollback command handy: `routectl set-priority inference-route:v2.13 && nodepool drain dedicated-canary-3`.
Olivia: Appreciate it. Closing checklist for now, leaving thread open for live reports during deploy.
